caption:
They laughed at the quiet girl in the back row.
Seedance 2.5 turned it into a full fight scene.
prompt:
use seedance 2.5 for this

VIDEO PROMPT — 30 seconds, 16:9 landscape. Look: ultra-photorealistic live-action Korean high-school action drama, 35mm cinematic lens, shallow depth of field in the close-ups, warm late-afternoon sunlight pouring through large windows on the right side of the room, golden backlight with visible dust in the sunbeams, soft warm-teal film grade, natural skin texture. Camera feel: calm slow push-ins for the build-up, then fast handheld close-combat camerawork with quick whip pans and motion blur for the fight, then a still, controlled ending. Pacing: slow and tense for 6 seconds, an explosive 17-second fight made of many short shots, then a calm wide shot and a slow final close-up, ending on black. No on-screen text, no subtitles, no logos.

CHARACTERS:
- THE GIRL: Korean high-school girl, about 17, slim, pale fair skin, sleek straight jet-black chin-length bob with blunt ends and a slight side part, thin straight brows, sharp narrow almond eyes, small natural pink lips, cold calm expression. Uniform: dark navy blazer with a small round gold pin badge on the left lapel and a small yellow name tag on the right chest, crisp white collared shirt, dark navy tie, dark navy pleated knee-length skirt, black short socks, black loafers. Her bob stays the same in every shot and swings and flares with every fast move.
- THE BULLY LEADER: Korean boy, about 18, broad face, very short cropped black hair with a short straight fringe, wide mocking grin. Navy blazer with a yellow name tag on the right chest and a round blue-and-white school crest on the left chest, white shirt, loosened navy tie, dark trousers.
- THE OTHER BOYS: six or seven Korean boys, 17-18, short black hair, same navy blazers with yellow name tags and round crests, white shirts, navy ties, dark trousers; a couple have their blazers open. Arrogant, laughing at first.

LOCATION: a real South Korean high-school classroom in daytime: rows of light-wood student desks on grey metal frames with matching wood-and-metal chairs, open notebooks and textbooks on the desks, black backpacks hanging on the chairs, light wooden floor. Right wall: tall windows with cream curtains, strong warm sun. Back wall: rows of light-wood cubby lockers under a green bulletin board. Front wall: a long green chalkboard with white notice boards pinned with papers on both sides, a small framed national flag centered above the board, and a plain wooden teacher's lectern standing in front of the board.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:02.7) — The class. Wide shot from the back-left of the room, slow push-in. Foreground left (soft focus): a laughing boy hunched over his desk, scribbling. Center, mid-ground: THE GIRL sits upright and still at her desk near the windows, knees together, notebook open. Around and behind her the boys lounge in their chairs, one leans far back laughing, others nudge each other and grin at her.

SHOT 2 (00:02.7-00:06.5) — The cold stare. Close-up of THE GIRL, front-on, locked-off with a very slow push-in; background: blurred wooden lockers and the blurred shoulder of a student on the left. She starts with her eyes lowered to her desk, then slowly raises them straight into the lens; her eyes narrow, her face stays perfectly still; at the very end a faint cold half-smile appears.

SHOT 3 (00:06.5-00:07.9) — The provocation. Medium close-up of THE BULLY LEADER seated at his desk, a window glowing behind him on the left and another boy smirking behind his right shoulder. He leans forward over the desk with a wide mocking grin, then lunges toward the camera with a snarling face. Fast push-in.

SHOT 4 (00:07.9-00:08.9) — First strike. Handheld medium shot: THE GIRL springs up from her chair, bob whipping around, and drives the BULLY LEADER backward; he flies back over a desk on the right of frame, arms flailing. Chalkboard and lockers behind, motion blur.

SHOT 5 (00:08.9-00:10.0) — Into the aisle. Handheld wider shot facing the front of the room: she spins away from a falling boy on the left and lands in a ready fighting stance in the middle aisle between the desks; in the background boys jump up from their seats and rush toward her.

SHOT 6 (00:10.0-00:11.0) — Block and counter. A second boy throws a big right punch from the right of frame; she slips it, then (camera now behind her shoulder) traps his arm and shoves him hard backward into the desks by the windows.

SHOT 7 (00:11.0-00:12.0) — Spin. Handheld tracking: she whirls around, hair flaring out horizontally, and throws a third boy past her; he stumbles across the aisle with his blazer flapping.

SHOT 8 (00:12.0-00:13.0) — Body blow. She charges a boy beside the window desks and strikes him in the stomach; he folds forward over a desk, books sliding off.

SHOT 9 (00:13.0-00:14.0) — Sweep. Low-angle handheld close to the floor: a boy lunges at her, she drops low under his arms and flips him over her back; loose white papers scatter across the floor.

SHOT 10 (00:14.0-00:15.3) — Breath. Medium shot from behind her as she stands in the aisle, shoulders square, hands loose; boys groan on the floor between the desks and two more boys at the back of the room hesitate, then come at her.

SHOT 11 (00:15.3-00:16.8) — Punch. Fast whip pan to a boy charging from the left; she lands a straight punch to his face, his head snaps sideways with heavy motion blur; camera swings round to her back as she turns toward the next one.

SHOT 12 (00:16.8-00:18.0) — Grapple at the front. Wider shot facing the front wall with the chalkboard, the small framed flag above it: a boy in an open blazer charges, she grabs him by the collar and tie and twists him around.

SHOT 13 (00:18.0-00:19.0) — Elbow. Handheld beside the teacher's lectern: she drives an elbow into a boy whose blazer and yellow name tag fill the right foreground; he drops and slides across the floor below the chalkboard.

SHOT 14 (00:19.0-00:20.8) — The last attacker. Wide shot facing the chalkboard: she spins to face the room; the last boy sprints and leaps at her from the front, arms out; she catches his momentum, turns and hurls him toward the front of the room.

SHOT 15 (00:20.8-00:23.5) — Paper storm. Locked-off wide shot of the front of the classroom: the boy flies over the wooden lectern and crashes down behind it out of sight; dozens of white sheets of paper burst into the air and slowly flutter down through the golden sunbeams in front of the green chalkboard. MUST SHOW: the white papers drifting down for the whole shot, the lectern center frame, the room now empty and still.

SHOT 16 (00:23.5-00:26.7) — Last one standing. Wide shot from the middle of the classroom, slight low angle across the desk rows: THE GIRL stands alone in the center aisle facing the camera, papers and fallen backpacks on the floor around her, a couple of boys sprawled behind the desks. She calmly straightens her blazer with both hands, then walks slowly toward the camera. Slow push-in.

SHOT 17 (00:26.7-00:29.3) — Final stare. Close-up of her face, background a soft blur of the green chalkboard and warm light, dust specks floating. She looks down first, then raises her eyes straight into the lens with a cold, satisfied half-smile; slow push-in to a tighter close-up. Her gold lapel pin catches the light.

SHOT 18 (00:29.3-00:30.1) — Cut to black.

SOUND: 00:00-06.5 quiet classroom ambience, boys' mocking laughter and chatter, a pencil scratching, a low tense synth drone and a slow heartbeat-like pulse building. 00:06.5 the bully's short mocking laugh. 00:07.9 a hard bass hit as she strikes, then an intense driving percussion and taiko-style drum action track; every move gets a crisp sound: punches thudding, cloth whooshing, chairs scraping, desks crashing, books slamming to the floor, boys grunting. 00:20.8 a heavy crash behind the lectern, then the music drops out to near silence with only papers rustling and dust settling. 00:23.5-29.3 soft low drone, her footsteps on the wooden floor. Black at the end: silence. No dialogue.
prompt_short: Photoreal Korean school action drama, 16:9. A calm girl with a sleek black bob in a navy uniform is mocked by bullies, stares them down, then takes out the whole class in a fast handheld fight. Papers rain down; she ends with a cold smile.
